title: QR Code Generator
description: Create QR codes for links, text, Wi-Fi, and Pix in the browser.
metaDescription: Create QR codes for links, text, Wi-Fi, and Pix in the browser, with SVG and PNG downloads.

form.title: Create QR Code
form.description: Choose the content type, adjust the look, and download the image generated in the browser.

text.label: Text
text.placeholder: Type or paste the text the QR Code should encode.

wifi.passwordWarning: This QR Code includes the network password. Share it only with people who should access it.

pix.label: Pix copy-and-paste text
pix.placeholder: Paste the Pix payload or another Pix-related text.
pix.note: This tool only encodes the text you provide. It does not validate the recipient, amount, or payment.

style.title: Style
style.description: Adjust size, margin, error correction, and QR Code colors.

privacy.title: Link privacy
privacy.description: By default, the page URL stores only type and style. The content stays in the browser.
privacy.includeContent: Include content in the shared link
privacy.safeShare: The current link does not include URL, text, Wi-Fi password, or Pix content.
privacy.publicWarning: Links with content can reveal data to anyone who receives them.

result.title: Preview

summary.url: The QR Code will point to the link you entered.
summary.texto: The QR Code will encode the text exactly as typed.
summary.wifi: The QR Code will encode Wi-Fi network access data.
summary.pix: The QR Code will encode the Pix text without validation.

result.empty: Enter valid content to generate the preview.

validation.contentRequired: Enter content to generate the QR Code.
validation.unsupportedUrlScheme: Use only http or https links.
validation.pixTooLong: The Pix text exceeds the 2,000-byte limit.
validation.ssidTooLong: The network name must be 32 bytes or fewer.
validation.wifiPasswordRequired: Enter the password or choose a no-password network.
validation.wifiPasswordLength: WPA passwords are usually 8 to 63 characters or 64 hexadecimal characters.
validation.wifiContainsPassword: This QR Code contains a Wi-Fi password.
validation.invalidForegroundColor: The main color must be hexadecimal.
validation.invalidBackgroundColor: The background color must be hexadecimal.
validation.sameColors: Use different colors for the QR Code and background.
validation.lowContrast: Contrast is low and may make scanning harder.

seo.about: The generator creates QR codes in the browser for links, text, Wi-Fi networks, and Pix copy-and-paste text. Content is not sent to the server or saved to favorites.
seo.howToUseTitle: How to create a QR Code
seo.howToUse: Choose the type, enter the content, and adjust colors, margin, size, and error correction. Use SVG for print or PNG for quick sharing. Include content in the link only when you want others to see that data.
